cards.card_text: Moses had struck them down and dispossessed them.
cards.verse_text: Moses had struck them down and dispossessed them,
cards.snippet: Moses had struck them down and dispossessed them,

cards.card_text: Lemuel's mother also tells the king to open his mouth for the cause of all the dispossessed.
cards.verse_text: Open your mouth for those with no voice, for the cause of all the dispossessed.
cards.snippet: …mouth for those with no voice, for the cause of all the dispossessed.

cards.card_text: Her descendants will dispossess the nations and move right into the desolate cities.
cards.verse_text: For you will spread out to the right and left; your descendants will dispossess the nations and inhabit the desolate cities.
cards.snippet: …you will spread out to the right and left; your descendants will dispossess the nations and inhabit the desolate cities.
